# dnd35-character-database

> Next.js 15 + Firebase app for managing D&D 3.5e character records with reusable MUI components.

This repository migrates a legacy single-page app to the Next.js App Router. Routing lives under `app/`, while reusable logic, domain models, and UI primitives are colocated in `src/`. Firebase emulators and hosting configs support local development and deployment.

## Documentation

- [Project README](README.md): Quick reference for development commands and deployment workflow.
- [Development Preview](.github/instructions/development-preview.instructions.md): Step-by-step guide for running Firebase emulators and Next.js dev server locally.
- [Next.js Guidelines](.github/instructions/nextjs.instructions.md): Internal best practices for building features with the App Router.
- [llms prompt - create](.github/prompts/create-llms.prompt.md): Authoring instructions for generating this llms.txt artifact.
- [llms prompt - update](.github/prompts/update-llms.prompt.md): Instructions for maintaining and updating this llms.txt file.
- [Bug report template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md): Standard form for capturing defects and reproduction steps.
- [Feature request template](.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md): Structure for proposing enhancements with acceptance criteria.

## Application Routes

- [App router](app/): Next.js App Router entry point, layout, theme setup, and route groupings.
- [Root page](app/page.tsx): Landing view that links into character browsing flows.
- [Character details](app/char/[id]/page.tsx): Server-rendered page for viewing a specific character sheet.
- [Edit character](app/edit/[id]/page.tsx): Client-enabled route for updating existing character data.
- [New character](app/new/page.tsx): Form-driven flow for creating a new character record.

## Domain Logic

- [Domain models](src/models/): TypeScript representations of abilities, skills, saves, equipment, and other 3.5e concepts.
- [Forms](src/forms/): React Hook Form powered components for create, edit, and view workflows.
- [Character sheet renderer](src/sheets/CharacterSheet.tsx): Presentation layer for assembled character data.
- [Persistence helpers](src/persistent/index.ts): Wrapper utilities for reading and writing character documents.
- [Firebase initialization](src/firebase/index.ts): Configuration bridge to Firebase SDK, auth, and Firestore services.

## UI Components

- [Shared components](src/components/): Reusable display primitives for labels, values, links, and dialogs.
- [Value presenter](src/components/Value.tsx): Core component for rendering scalar fields with consistent styling.
- [Character list](src/components/ListChars.tsx): List view for browsing characters in the database.
- [Dirty dialog](src/components/DirtyDialog.tsx): Navigation guard dialog shown when unsaved form changes exist.

## Configuration

- [package.json](package.json): Project metadata, Next.js scripts, and dependency manifest.
- [next.config.ts](next.config.ts): Next.js runtime configuration for the app build.
- [tsconfig.json](tsconfig.json): TypeScript compiler settings used across the project.
- [firebase.json](firebase.json): Firebase emulator, hosting, and deploy configuration.
- [firestore.rules](firestore.rules): Security rules protecting Firestore collections.
- [database.rules.json](database.rules.json): Realtime Database read/write permissions for legacy tooling.
- [apphosting.yaml](apphosting.yaml): Firebase App Hosting deployment settings (see prod/dev overrides).
- [biome.json](biome.json): Biome formatter and lint configuration for code quality.
- [eslint.config.mjs](eslint.config.mjs): ESLint configuration aligned with Next.js best practices.
